title: 好文案包
tagline: 文档和公告写得像人话

editor_note.text: 治「写得像机器人」:writing-guidelines 是 Vercel 那套写作规范——短句、砍废话、别自嗨;internal-comms 专攻公司内部通告的分寸感;doc-coauthoring 适合和 Claude 你一段我一段磨长文。三件一起装,出来的东西至少像个认真的人写的。中文场景里它有些规则偏英文习惯,取其神就好。
editor_note.author: 主理人
editor_note.text_en: A cure for “reads like a robot”: writing-guidelines is Vercel's writing standard — short sentences, cut filler, no self-congratulation; internal-comms handles the tone of company announcements; doc-coauthoring is for grinding out long docs with Claude paragraph by paragraph. Installed together, the output at least reads like a person who cares. Some rules lean toward English habits — in Chinese contexts, take the spirit, not the letter.

tagline_en: Docs and announcements that read like a human
